root_derivation.home: absolute operator HOME, never a supplied alternate root
root_derivation.selection: migrated only when its receipt matches exactly; otherwise legacy

fabric.policy: dedicated fixture Fabric node, never ambient or production
fabric.execution: pin FABRIC_HOME and global --home to exact derived fixture Fabric home on every invocation
fabric.scope: separate authenticated Fabric-mesh start/stop scope required
fabric.source_prerequisite: dedicated Fabric context source must land before execution

title: Client control fixture check
text_policy: printable ASCII, 1-60 characters, no Markdown *_#[]`>|, no JSON, no leading/trailing/repeated whitespace

generated_schema.fabric_node_id: actual dedicated Fabric NodeID, separate from daemon node_id
generated_schema.run_id: nonempty string from actual run issuance
generated_schema.ask_id: nonempty native ask subject string from seed receipt
generated_schema.attention_item_id: nonempty projection ID from seed receipt, not the navigation target
generated_schema.claim_ids: array of actual durable claim IDs
generated_schema.grant_ids: array of actual issued grant IDs
generated_schema.device_ids: array of actual enrolled device IDs

acceptance.e1: fresh fixture creation provenance, one ask creation timestamp, only seed own person-relevant claim IDs before first journey
acceptance.e2: independent before/after every journey; E2 claim and receipt comparison unchanged
acceptance.e3: fresh profile before enrollment, never reset; baseline immediately after enrollment, same enrolled key/session; E3 diff recorded after every journey
acceptance.exclusions: named storage-inventory.json keys bound to concrete actual selectors; no globs, normal profiles, broad cache exclusions or secret dumps
acceptance.identity: primary authoritative daemon-verified signed receipts use one enrolled public key, unchanged enrollment row/id; local readback secondary; pairing id only from fixture store
acceptance.fingerprint: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 SEC1 point 0x04||X||Y
acceptance.state_classes: identity preserved; named expected_churn diffed and marker-scanned; all unexplained, identity, marker or unscanned changes are FINDING
acceptance.markers: any persisted item read/seen/acted/closed marker is FINDING for Fractal Product Lead, never PASS
acceptance.missing_evidence: OPEN; source publication establishes none of E1-E3
acceptance.no_local_state: declared limitation requires file:line source evidence

consent: standalone authenticated consent bound to exact executable packet_sha256 and input_sha256; source preparation is not authorization
normal_instance: excluded: root, store, socket, sessions, grants and enrollments
